title: Lean4Agent：基于形式化建模与验证的智能体工作流与轨迹框架
summary: Lean4Agent 是首个利用依赖类型形式语言 Lean4 对智能体工作流与执行轨迹进行形式化建模与验证的框架。它包含 FormalAgentLib 库和 LeanEvolve 优化工具，实验表明验证通过的工作流性能平均提升 11.94%，LeanEvolve 进一步改善 SWE 性能 7.47%。
summary_en: Lean4Agent is the first framework using Lean4, a dependent-type formal language, to model and verify agent workflows and execution trajectories. It includes FormalAgentLib for semantic consistency verification and LeanEvolve for workflow revision, achieving 11.94% average improvement for verified workflows and 7.47% further SWE performance gain.
